mapper.select: SELECT es.effect_state_id, es.skill_level_id, es.state_code, es.state_name, es.attack_add, es.attack_mul, es.element_add, es.element_mul, es.affinity_add, es.crit_damage_mul, es.defense_add, es.defense_mul, es.fire_res_add, es.water_res_add, es.thunder_res_add, es.ice_res_add, es.dragon_res_add, es.shot_mul, es.phial_mul, es.fixed_damage_add, es.status_add, es.status_mul, es.sharpness_add, es.recovery_mul, es.element_damage_mul, es.element_crit_damage_mul, es.weapon_type, es.armor_skill_level_add, es.physical_damage_mul, es.activation_chance, es.bounce_prevention_chance, es.artillery_damage_mul, es.all_element_res_set, es.nullify_non_dragon_element, es.activation_hp_threshold_pct, es.nullify_status, es.resistance_to_element_rate, es.guarantee_status_accumulation, es.effect_duration_seconds, es.recovery_threshold, es.required_sharpness_recovery_stages, es.poison_duration_mul, es.close_range_coating_mul_override, es.unlock_bow_charge_stage, es.bowgun_custom_attack_mul_override, es.additional_damage_attack_mul, es.additional_damage_ignore_hitzone, es.damage_heal_ratio FROM skill_effect_state es INNER JOIN skill_level sl ON sl.skill_level_id = es.skill_level_id WHERE sl.skill_id = #{skillId} AND sl.level = #{level} AND ( es.weapon_type IS NULL OR es.weapon_type = #{weaponType} ) ORDER BY es.state_code

SELECT es.effect_state_id, es.skill_level_id, es.state_code, es.state_name, es.attack_add, es.attack_mul, es.element_add, es.element_mul, es.affinity_add, es.crit_damage_mul, es.defense_add, es.defense_mul, es.fire_res_add, es.water_res_add, es.thunder_res_add, es.ice_res_add, es.dragon_res_add, es.shot_mul, es.phial_mul, es.fixed_damage_add, es.status_add, es.status_mul, es.sharpness_add, es.recovery_mul, es.element_damage_mul, es.element_crit_damage_mul, es.weapon_type, es.armor_skill_level_add, es.physical_damage_mul, es.activation_chance, es.bounce_prevention_chance, es.artillery_damage_mul, es.all_element_res_set, es.nullify_non_dragon_element, es.activation_hp_threshold_pct, es.nullify_status, es.resistance_to_element_rate, es.guarantee_status_accumulation, es.effect_duration_seconds, es.recovery_threshold, es.required_sharpness_recovery_stages, es.poison_duration_mul, es.close_range_coating_mul_override, es.unlock_bow_charge_stage, es.bowgun_custom_attack_mul_override, es.additional_damage_attack_mul, es.additional_damage_ignore_hitzone, es.damage_heal_ratio FROM skill_effect_state es INNER JOIN skill_level sl ON sl.skill_level_id = es.skill_level_id WHERE sl.skill_id = #{skillId} AND sl.level = #{level} AND es.state_code = #{stateCode} AND ( es.weapon_type IS NULL OR es.weapon_type = #{weaponType} ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN es.weapon_type = #{weaponType} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1
